title: Conversational analytics QA processor with ServiceNow QA tasks
scenario: Larkspur's QA team hand-reviews 2% of calls and missed an agent asking a caller for their password. Build a processor over conversational analytics (Contact Lens) post-contact output files and real-time segment events that computes per-agent sentiment and compliance KPIs, raises idempotent ServiceNow QA tasks for findings, and alerts supervisors during live calls.
task: Accept only redacted, completed analysis files; report rejections
Implement greeting, closing, disclosure, escalation and prohibited-language rules
Compute per-agent KPIs from ConversationCharacteristics (sentiment, talk time, interruptions)
Real-time monitor over segment stream events with dedupe and once-per-type alerts
ServiceNow Table API client: OAuth client credentials, 401 re-auth, Retry-After, idempotent create
acceptance: Raw and failed files never enter the pipeline
Rule results, KPI values and real-time alerts match the fixtures
Exactly one QA task per (contact, rule) with the right priority, no transcript text, re-run creates nothing
Bounded retries and no retry storm on bad credentials
